context: This week's 12 teams put up 1588.2 points between them, 132.35 a team.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Somewhere, Jordan Love is still on Bandits's bench wondering why -- 46.18 points' worth of wondering, out of 77.58 total left stranded.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Newman’s Owen put up a bottom-half 117.06 and still walked away with a win, thanks to Tanner Time's 107.18.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: Big Dumb Sports never had a chance against Supernovas, managing only 84.2 points all week.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: Not close: packerlove24 beat Supernova Takeover by 44.96 points, 179.04 to 134.08.
